permissions.comment: Read-only inspection + the verify-changes build/test commands are pre-approved so they never prompt. Survives the cafe-PC defreezer because it lives in the repo. Deliberately omits git commit/push and rm — CLAUDE.md says commit only when asked, so those stay prompt-gated.
permissions.comment_defaultMode: auto = the auto-classifier permission mode (NOT acceptEdits/edit-automatically, which Neil dislikes). Safe actions auto-approve; risky/destructive ones (commit/push, rm) still prompt = Neil's 'auto-run, I review commits' (2026-07-01). Lives in the repo so it survives the cafe-PC defreezer; a machine-local toggle would not. First use may show a one-time auto-mode opt-in dialog to accept.
permissions.comment_adSpend: Meta Ads WRITE tools are deliberately absent here. They used to be auto-approved, which contradicted the grifon-ad-strategist hard rule ('never spend Neil's money autonomously') — create_campaign + create_ad_set + create_creative + create_ad is the complete chain to a live spending campaign, with no prompt anywhere in it. Enforcement now lives in the ad-spend-gate.sh PreToolUse hook (deny on spend switches, ask on staging writes), which also covers the `meta-ads` CLI path over Bash that an allowlist cannot see. Only read tools stay allowlisted.
